## Additional Analytics Work

Beyond sports, I’ve worked on projects involving Monte Carlo simulation, survey analysis, employee attrition modeling, and applied statistical reporting. These projects use similar core skills: cleaning data, building reproducible workflows, modeling uncertainty, and communicating results clearly.

## About

My background sits between statistics, sports media, and communication, which has shaped how I think about analytics. I care about the model or method, but I also care about whether the result can be understood, trusted, and used.

A lot of strong analysis gets ignored because it is trapped in a spreadsheet, buried in a notebook, or presented in a way that does not match the audience. I’m interested in closing that gap by turning messy data into something clear, visual, and worth engaging with.

Most of my work is built in R using Quarto, Shiny, R Markdown, ggplot2, tidyverse, and API-based data workflows.
